title: HYP-M16-SOLVER-SLOPE-001: current-seed desk abstention for an unchanged mechanism
hypothesis_statement: Conditional on a future exact source-faithful recovery theorem, a safe regime with identified relation yield, and a complete common-unit cost bridge, the published arity-16 composed-subgroup relation system could be tested for a causal reduction in generalized-root solving work that survives rank, sparse linear algebra, and equal-success single-target accounting. TASK-028 supplies the exact input and a sound acceptance filter but none of those missing conditions, so this proposal requests no compute and makes no scaling claim.
new_premise: With one fixed synthetic DLP target Q and fresh committed relation points R_j = [alpha_j]G + [beta_j]Q, the source-composed arity-16 membership circuit retains a growing sparse-elimination advantage in expected work per attempted system over separated literal, multiplicative-coset, root-histogram, and randomized-DAG controls; after exact signed recovery and rank, that advantage also survives complete single-target cost.
premise_counterfactual: If the unchanged composed-subgroup mechanism has no new cost-changing premise, then duplicate screening rejects this submission; independently, if pointwise circuit equivalence does not transfer solver complexity, direct-system recovery remains incomplete, or complete work retains square-root growth, the proposed slope advantage has no supported cost bridge.

source_objects: direct source System (4) with 64 factor coordinates and 65 equation members at arity sixteen
literal composed map L4 o L3 o L2 o L1 = 1 - x^564522
one fixed synthetic Q with fresh committed alpha_j, beta_j, and nonidentity R_j
target_objects: independently verified signed relation rows retaining alpha_j and beta_j
a complete single-target cost ledger through recovery, rank, and sparse linear algebra

transformation.exact_map: Fix Q = [z]G. For attempt j commit alpha_j, beta_j and nonidentity R_j = [alpha_j]G + [beta_j]Q. Constrain each of sixteen leaves by the literal four-stage map x^2, x^3, x^7, 1-x^13441 and couple their first coordinates through target-specialized S17. Accept only an independently checked signed relation, normalize the target coefficient to -1, retain the row (c_1j,...,c_Uj,-beta_j) with right-hand side alpha_j, replay rank, and verify [z]G = Q.
transformation.domain: A future separately authorized safe synthetic cofactor-one prime-order toy family, exact source-chain systems, fixed Q, fresh committed relation points, a complete exceptional policy, exact yield and recovery accounting, and matched controls. The current at-most-24-bit policy scope is desk-only for M16 exponent inference.
transformation.codomain: Validated signed relation and rejection records plus a complete common-unit setup, solving, recovery, rank, linear-algebra, and verification ledger. No such records or ledger are produced here.

fixed_target_semantics.target_slot: Q is the single fixed synthetic DLP target; each source system contains the attempt-specific nonidentity relation point R_j.
fixed_target_semantics.target_action: Commit Q once and commit alpha_j, beta_j, and R_j before solver randomness. Classify R_j = O outside the affine specialization. Preserve Q and the coefficient stream across within-curve controls; cross-family controls preserve scalar semantics but use their own curve points.

exceptional_locus.definition: Identity relation targets, infinity slots, invalid projective pairs, failed base-field lifts, extension-only intermediates, repeated or tangent fibers, conditional regular-locus failures, duplicate relations, and rank-deficient rows.

orbit_stabilizer.acting_group: The exact order-three GLV coordinate action is available only as a constant-factor structural ablation.
orbit_stabilizer.stabilizer: TASK-027 records exact public-parameter orbit counts, but no quotient is treated as a factor-log column without additional relation semantics.
orbit_stabilizer.orbit_size_law: Orbit size is three and independent of the field-size exponent, so it cannot supply the proposed cost-changing lever.

relation_semantics.source_relation: A candidate is retained only when independently recovered signed factor-base points and the committed R_j satisfy sum_i epsilon_i P_i + epsilon_R R_j = O; normalize the complete relation to target coefficient -1.
relation_semantics.target_relation: The normalized row verifies sum_i c_ij*lambda_i - beta_j*z = alpha_j modulo q, rank is recomputed over Z/qZ, and a recovered z must satisfy [z]G = Q.

recovery_map.forward: Record the literal 64-coordinate and 65-equation source system, committed target data, solver trace, every raw assignment, field lifts, signs, multiplicities, exceptional dispositions, and cost receipts.
recovery_map.inverse: Independently lift every finite leaf, replay signs and multiplicities, require the target-bound group relation, normalize target sign, retain alpha_j and beta_j, aggregate duplicates, verify the row, replay rank and sparse linear algebra, and verify [z]G = Q.
excluded_components: identity targets outside the affine specialization
recovery_map.spurious_solution_policy: Reject and classify every assignment that fails the literal source equations, base-field lift, exceptional policy, signed target-bound group replay, or row verification. Passing this filter proves soundness only; complete direct-System-(4) recovery remains unproved.

cost_changing_mechanism.quantity: Expected complete equal-success single-target primitive-operation work, with the unresolved generalized-root term separated from recovery, rank, and sparse linear algebra.
cost_changing_mechanism.causal_bridge: The unchanged conjecture attributes a growing sparse-elimination advantage to the composed subgroup presentation. TASK-028 proves neither ideal equivalence for a quadratic circuit nor a generalized-root cost bound, so the causal bridge is only specified and is not evidence-backed.
cost_changing_mechanism.growth_law: A future distinct proposal would need exact control-matched upper bounds below 7/16 for per-attempt work and below 1/2 for complete work. No eligible ladder or bound is supplied here.
cost_changing_mechanism.non_orbit_lever: Any claimed lever would have to arise from the multiplicative-subgroup representation after complete recovery, not the finite GLV orbit.

nearest_prior_art.reference: Petit, Kosters, and Messeng, Algebraic Approaches for the Elliptic Curve Discrete Logarithm Problem over Prime Fields, PKC 2016
nearest_prior_art.locator: Algorithm 1 and Sections 3.1-3.3, especially System (4), the p-minus-one map, and the partial cost formula
nearest_prior_art.overlap: The source defines the composed factor base, fixed DLP target with fresh sampled relation points, exact direct relation-system shape, heuristic relation yield, and partial cost formula used here.
nearest_prior_art.difference: This repository adds only a target-bound sound acceptance filter and explicit complete-cost requirements. It does not add the generalized-root algorithm, recovery-completeness theorem, or cost-changing bound left open by the source.

nearest_prior_art.reference: Amadori, Pintore, and Sala, On the Discrete Logarithm Problem for Prime-Field Elliptic Curves, 2018
nearest_prior_art.locator: Sections 3-4, including the unproved comparison of system-solving terms
nearest_prior_art.overlap: The paper studies a related prime-field summation-polynomial pipeline and reports small toy systems while leaving the decisive single-system cost poorly understood.
nearest_prior_art.difference: The current submission refuses to transfer a toy or representation observation into a complete M16 slope claim without exact direct-system recovery and equal-success cost accounting.

exact_mechanism.map: For sixteen leaves apply the literal source chain x^2, x^3, x^7, 1-x^13441 and the target-specialized direct S17 equation for a committed nonidentity R_j = [alpha_j]G + [beta_j]Q; independently verify and normalize a signed target-bound relation before constructing a row for rank and z recovery.
exact_mechanism.domain: A future safe synthetic cofactor-one prime-order toy family with fixed Q, varying committed nonidentity R_j, literal source systems, complete exceptional semantics, exact yield and recovery, matched controls, and no production target. No such executable domain is frozen here.
exact_mechanism.codomain: Independently verified relation, rank, linear-algebra, and candidate-key records plus a complete equal-success single-target work ledger. No output is produced in this cycle.
exact_mechanism.relation_semantics: Normalize an independently checked relation sum_i epsilon_i P_i + epsilon_R R_j = O to target coefficient -1, yielding sum_i c_ij*lambda_i - beta_j*z = alpha_j modulo q. Polynomial satisfaction without group replay is rejected.
exact_mechanism.fixed_target_semantics: Q is fixed once; alpha_j, beta_j, and R_j are committed per attempt before solver randomness. Identity R_j is outside the displayed affine system and requires a separate frozen disposition.
exact_mechanism.exceptional_locus: Existing formal work classifies a recursive projective presentation and proves conditional affine reductions, but direct-System-(4) recovery completeness, regular-locus coverage, and its cost remain unproved.
exact_mechanism.recovery_map: Lift leaves, preserve signs and multiplicities, independently verify the target-bound relation, normalize the row, aggregate duplicates, retain alpha_j and beta_j, replay rank and sparse linear algebra, and verify [z]G = Q. This complete inverse is specified but not proved or implemented.
exact_mechanism.implementation_identity: The mechanism digest binds a design note only. No producer, direct-System-(4) solver, baseline executable, input generator, recovery implementation, or runtime validator exists; the authorized compute budget is zero.

non_generic_information_source: The proposed mechanism uses explicit prime-field coordinates, the multiplicative-subgroup chain defining 1-x^564522, and the target-specialized Semaev polynomial system, none of which is available through a classical black-box group oracle.
null_model: Once literal-chain identity, root and lift counts, sparse topology, ordering, coefficient streams, timeouts, recovery, rank, and complete single-target work are controlled, the composed presentation has no uniquely growing advantage over matched plain representations or generic square-root work.
competing_mechanism: Any local effect may arise from representation size, monomial ordering, generic sparse-DAG topology, root/lift histogram, repetition, conditional regular-locus filtering, or the finite GLV orbit rather than a cost-changing multiplicative-subgroup mechanism.

cost_bridge.baseline: The complete comparison would use Pollard rho at the same group order, fixed Q, 50 percent end-to-end success, and one frozen primitive-operation unit, plus matched plain relation representations sharing all feasible within-curve inputs.
cost_bridge.changed_term: The only source-grounded symbolic expression is P(p,16)+(16!*p/D^15)T(E,16,L)+D^omega. TASK-028 leaves T, complete recovery, rank, sparse linear algebra, and common-unit total work unresolved, so no changed complete-cost term is established.
cost_bridge.online_cost: A future ledger must include every attempted system, failure and timeout, direct-system solving, base-field recovery and rejection, signed row normalization, rank, sparse linear algebra, candidate z recovery, and [z]G = Q verification. No online work is authorized here.
cost_bridge.offline_cost: A future single-target ledger must include factor-base construction, the literal four-stage map representation, polynomial and solver preprocessing, reusable matrices, exceptional-branch orchestration, recovery tables, and validator setup after public p,E,G,Q are fixed.
cost_bridge.memory_cost: A future ledger must record polynomial and monomial inventories, matrix rows, columns, nonzeros and fill, solver and sparse-linear-algebra peak memory, retained relations, validator memory, and storage. No bound is currently known.
cost_bridge.parallelism: Any successor must report aggregate worker work and critical-path time under an immutable worker cap and may claim no free parallel speedup.
cost_bridge.precomputation: All attack setup after the public curve and fixed Q are known must be hashed and charged in full for the single target; experimental family search must be reported separately and cannot hide adversarial work.
cost_bridge.amortization_scope: No multi-target, wallet, nonce, preprocessing-oracle, or reusable-setup amortization is credited; target_count remains one.
cost_bridge.scaling_claim: No scaling claim is made. The at-most-24-bit regime is inapplicable to M16 exponent inference, and no exact bound below p^(7/16) per attempt or p^(1/2) end to end is available.
